title: Agency processing reservations and amendments
topic: tax agency capacity jurisdiction receipt deadline handover
applicability: Tax handovers with a processing capacity contract
content: An agency processing contract reserves principal capacity across its named jurisdictions. Reservations close at booking_cutoff, before the retiring agent census normally returns. Processing consumes reserved capacity in the tax jurisdiction, and all reservations share total_capacity_minor. Fees are charged from the same company cash as the original tax payments. Unused principal capacity can move between jurisdictions through transfer_cutoff for a nonrefundable amendment fee. The agency’s eventual approval and configured jurisdiction route remain separately necessary. Capacity is a service right, not an authority payment or a credit against tax. Receipt allocation does not replenish already consumed service capacity.

provenance.scope: Fictional service capacity, direct route limits and allocation ranges.
